source_eligibility.ambiguous_duplicate_symbols: exclude from transported carrier and do not backfill

transport_prediction.initial_state: candidate cell line observed Control carrier mean
transport_prediction.generator: matching M397 publication-equation Drug ON generator and basal vector transported unchanged

comparators.constant_state: candidate Control state carried forward unchanged

M397_empirical_displacement_template.prediction: candidate Control plus M397 observed carrier displacement from D0
M397_empirical_displacement_template.M397_carrier_values: use the same unambiguous transported gene subset for source and target so missing-gene coverage does not alter the displacement basis

primary_metric.name: aggregate_statewise_variance_normalized_SSE
primary_metric.aggregation: sum across both states and all four carriers, post-Control points only
primary_metric.pass_rule: unchanged generator aggregate must be strictly lower than both constant-state and M397 empirical-displacement-template aggregates

secondary_metrics: D3 cosine similarity between predicted and observed displacement
scientific_effect_if_pass: supports held-out cross-cell-line behavioral transport of the frozen M397 generator family at P0-Q and closes the current Bio Chi C3 behavior gate positively
scientific_effect_if_fail: Bio Chi cross-system behavior transport is not established by this source; preserve failure and move to a different qualified oncology system if available
scalar_effect: none; no target-system scalar is constructed without a target-system native generator
